evidence_checked: re-hashed cited text files and quote spans (same files as blind review; only dates differ from the planted claim, confirmed by field diff)
reasoning: The genuine claim differs from the planted one only in the six end dates: rows A1(b), A2(b) and A3(b) end 1945-06-30 by their own 'For the fiscal year 1945' wording, and B1 and B6 end 1946-07-01 by EO 9744B, which supersedes 'Executive Orders Nos. 9356 ..., 9447 of June 8, 1944, ...' and 'shall be in effect for the fiscal year 1947' (signing 1946-06-29 is the stated alternative). whole_order_end 1946-07-01 is the latest clause end. These dates now match the judgment reasons and the sources. Hashes and quote spans match (the cited files are the same as in the blind review). Identity matches 9 FR 6293 (June 8, 1944, amends EO 9356, effective July 1, 1944). The five-clause inventory covers the whole operative text. Earlier-end test: I read the held texts of EO 9465 (A6(b) only), EO 9525 (adds A9), EO 9583 (July 2, 1945, effective July 1, 1945; rewrites A1-A3 (a) and (b) for fiscal year 1946) and EO 9642 (A1(b), A2(b), A3(b) for fiscal year 1946, effective October 15, 1945). None touches B1 or B6, and none ends the fiscal-year-1945 rows before June 30, 1945. The OFR note 'Superseded by: EO 9744-B, June 29, 1946' is addressed. Savings is correctly stated. Two observations do not change the verdict. (1) The earlier_end_check names EO 9465, 9525 and 9642 but not EO 9583, the first fiscal-year-1946 rewrite of the same three rows. That rewrite takes effect July 1, 1945, after the rows' own end, so the ending is unaffected, and the rationale refers generally to the other orders listed in EO 9744B. (2) The first_end source for the three rows cites the whole page file (chars 0-13355, including EO 9446) rather than the fiscal-year wording. The span does contain that wording, so it locates the correct document but is imprecise. A corrected version should name EO 9583 and narrow the span.
